about: Publish destination registry (ADR 0005 D9; checked by policy rule P12). Created empty by milestone 0014 Story 02.0 Task 03; entries owned by milestone 0012 Story 04.0 (Task 02 adds github-release, Task 05 adds the rest and moves each module to scripts/ci/destinations/<name>.py). Entry form: {name, enabled, tier, permission_class, environment, credentials}. github-release (Task 02) and vcpkg-registry (Task 03: phases prepare, unprivileged, and branch, which creates registry/v<version> and never opens a PR) ship enabled: false: no release-tier destination may be enabled until threat-model settings S-1..S-8 are applied, read back and recorded in docs/dev/ci.md and the milestone status (docs/security/2026-11-18-release-and-publish-automation.md, standing constraint 12); stage.py publish refuses a disabled destination except with --dry-run. How to add one: docs/dev/adding-a-publish-destination.md.
